comment: Independent C-first recording for options.c:optfn_statushilites()'s do_set arm, reached from the full options menu's 'Set statushilites to what?' prompt through parseoptions(). The answer 5 sets iflags.hilite_delta and, because go.opt_from_file is FALSE, botl.c reset_status_hilites() clears both banks' timers and requests a full status repaint. A second visit rebuilds the menu, whose statushilites row reads its value through get_val, searches for the option and cancels with Escape; two steps east then play on.
